newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-WICKY SET TO JOIN WERDER BREMEN, AGENCY SAYS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WICKY SET TO JOIN WERDER BREMEN, AGENCY SAYS.

text.p: Swiss international Raphael Wicky will finalise his transfer to German first division Werder Bremen this week, the Swiss Sports Information news agency said on Monday.
The agency said Werder, sixth in the Bundesliga table, wanted the 19-year-old defender immediately.
But Sion, Wicky's Swiss league club, may not be prepared to release the player until next season.
They are still involved in the European Cup Winners' Cup, facing Liverpool in the second leg of the second round on Thursday, and are fighting for the leadership of the domestic league.
Wicky, capped three times, is considered one of the most promising players ever developed in Switzerland.
